name: list_events
description: List a service's event history: deploys, builds, restarts, failures, scaling, suspensions, and disk changes. Use it to find out what happened to a service and why. Failure events carry the reason a service went down, such as out-of-memory kills, non-zero exits, failed health checks, and evictions, which may not show up in logs. The first page covers the last 7 days unless startTime says otherwise. For older events, page with the cursor from the previous call. If the first page comes back empty there is no cursor to follow, so set an earlier startTime instead. Events cover services only, not Postgres or Key Value instances.

cursor.description: A unique string that corresponds to a position in the result list. If provided, the endpoint returns results that appear after the corresponding position. To fetch the first page of results, set to the empty string.

endTime.description: End of the time range in RFC3339 format (e.g. '2024-01-01T13:00:00Z'). Defaults to the current time.

eventTypes.description: Filter to specific event types. Returns all types when omitted. For debugging a failure, server_failed, deploy_ended, build_ended, and image_pull_failed carry the most detail.

limit.description: The maximum number of events to return, newest first.

serviceId.description: The ID of the service to list events for

startTime.description: Start of the time range in RFC3339 format (e.g. '2024-01-01T12:00:00Z'). Defaults to 7 days ago on the first page. Set it to reach events older than that.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the Render workspace to use. Reuse the workspaceId the user confirmed from list_workspaces.
